name: terminal/project-setup
title: Set up a project
summary: Set up a project so it runs: detect the stack, create the environment, install, build, test.
when: Use when a freshly cloned or unpacked project has to be made to run on this machine.
steps: Call list_files and read_files on package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod to identify the stack.
Call read_file on the README and any Makefile or scripts to learn the commands the project expects.
Call run_command with python3 --version, node --version and the other tool versions to confirm they exist.
Call multi_command with the environment and install commands the manifest implies, cwd set to the project, stop_on_error true.
Call multi_command with the build and test commands, such as npm run build and npm test, and read where it stops.
Call terminal_session action start for a server the project needs, then action status to read its startup output.
If install or build fails, read the first real error; when the network is down, say so and use packages already installed.
Report the commands that worked, the test result and how to start the app, and say plainly what still fails.
next: The final answer must give the setup commands that worked, the test result and the command that starts the app, plus what still fails.
